router.title: Default Repository Agent — orchestration and routing

items.label: Reads
items.text: .github/copilot-instructions.md, .github/agents/CherryMon.agent.md, docs/00_HOME.md and the user request.

items.label: Runs
items.text: Triage → classify intent → select authoritative owner → preserve upstream gate/acceptance criteria → handoff → consolidate result.

items.label: Writes
items.text: Normally no duplicate domain artifact; durable outputs belong to the specialist owner.

items.label: Routes
items.text: Requirement ambiguity → BusinessAnalyst; architecture/design → SolutionArchitect; implementation → GeneralCoding/domain owner; validation → TestEngineer.

items.label: Reads
items.text: governance, CherryMon, docs/00_HOME.md, existing REQ-*, relevant architecture/ADR and domain constraints.

items.label: Runs
items.text: Frame → Define → Make Testable → Decompose/Route.

items.label: Writes
items.text: docs/backlog/requirements/REQ-*.md using REQUIREMENT_TEMPLATE.md.

items.label: Handoff
items.text: READY_FOR_DESIGN → SolutionArchitect; READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION → GeneralCoding/domain owner; ambiguity stays with BA.

items.label: Reads
items.text: ready REQ-*, docs/architecture/**, docs/adr/**, matching domain instructions, current source/tests and CherryMon constraints.

items.label: Runs
items.text: Context → Current State → Proposed Design → Decision Check → Archify synchronization.

items.label: Writes
items.text: docs/architecture/**, docs/adr/** when required, Archify typed source and synchronized generated HTML.

items.label: Handoff
items.text: APPROVED_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION → GeneralCoding/domain owner only after required design artifacts and validation are synchronized.

chart.title: Chart.agent.md — visualization decision and Flint authoring

items.label: Reads
items.text: .github/instructions/chart.instructions.md, .github/skills/chart-authoring/SKILL.md, docs/architecture/Chart_Architecture.md and the actual data contract.

items.label: Runs
items.text: Understand → Recommend → Map to Flint → Transform if needed → Validate → Render/Compile → Sanity Check.

items.label: Writes
items.text: Chart recommendation/spec/render artifacts and chart-related durable documentation when needed.

items.label: Handoff
items.text: Advisory/spec/render may return to User; production integration → GeneralCoding → TestEngineer.

items.label: Reads
items.text: ready requirement/design, CherryMon, matching .github/instructions/*.instructions.md, relevant docs, source, scripts and nearest tests.

items.label: Runs
items.text: Confirm → Inspect → Implement → Update Materials → Developer Verification → Handoff.

items.label: Writes
items.text: src/**, scripts/**, implementation-side tests when in scope, affected canonical docs/runbooks and ChangeRequest trace when applicable.

items.label: Handoff
items.text: IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_VALIDATION → TestEngineer. FAIL/REGRESSION returns from TestEngineer through the bounded AUTOFIX loop; fix the defect and resubmit the same scope for independent validation.

items.label: Reads
items.text: .github/instructions/testing.instructions.md, requirement/acceptance criteria, approved architecture/domain contracts, implementation handoff, tests and runbooks.

items.label: Runs
items.text: Define → Prepare → Execute → Evaluate → classify PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / REGRESSION.

items.label: Writes
items.text: Independent test evidence, tests/** when validation assets belong here, and durable docs/runbook/** evidence when appropriate.

items.label: Handoff
items.text: PASS → verdict/User; FAIL or REGRESSION caused by implementation → GeneralCoding AUTOFIX loop; requirement gap → BA; design gap → SA; blocker → Router/User.

items.label: Reads
items.text: docs/architecture/Indicator_Engine.md, .github/instructions/indicators.instructions.md, calcEngine source, indicator metadata/config and CherryMon MCP evidence.

items.label: Runs
items.text: Discover → PHASE 1 metadata transaction → PHASE 2 targeted historical backfill → PHASE 3 validation/handoff.

items.label: Writes
items.text: Indicator metadata/config lifecycle and scoped cal_indicator_values/backfill behavior through the approved implementation path.

items.label: Handoff
items.text: IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_VALIDATION with ConfigIds/evidence → TestEngineer; architecture-impacting change routes through SolutionArchitect.

items.label: Owns
items.text: Repository-wide routing and precedence, not a domain implementation outcome.

items.label: Routes
items.text: User intent to the authoritative Agent that owns the required outcome.

items.label: Rule
items.text: Governance does not absorb Skill procedures, domain knowledge or Tool syntax.

items.label: Owns
items.text: The engineering outcome and readiness/handoff decision for its role.

items.label: Reads
items.text: Mandatory Instructions and the smallest relevant Docs set.

items.label: Invokes
items.text: A reusable Skill when a specialist procedure applies; evaluates resulting evidence before handoff or completion.

items.label: Owns
items.text: Non-optional domain constraints and repository rules.

items.label: Applies to
items.text: Agents and Skills operating in the matching scope.

items.label: Does not own
items.text: Step-by-step procedures, architecture explanation or tool capability.

items.label: Owns
items.text: Current architecture, ADR rationale, domain/reference knowledge and durable design context.

items.label: Read by
items.text: Agents and Skills through docs/00_HOME.md and the smallest relevant document set.

items.label: Does not own
items.text: Runtime orchestration or mandatory procedural enforcement.

items.label: Owns
items.text: Repeatable procedure for a specialized task.

items.label: Reads
items.text: Matching Instructions and relevant Docs; remains reusable across authorized callers.

items.label: Uses
items.text: Tool/MCP/script/API capability to perform the procedure; does not own the final Agent outcome.

items.label: Provides
items.text: MCP, CLI, script, API, GitHub, DuckDB, Archify, Flint or similar execution capability.

items.label: Returns
items.text: Artifacts, evidence or effects to the invoking procedure/Agent.

items.label: Does not own
items.text: Architecture decisions, business outcomes or final readiness gates.
